examples.title: Read power or sample size from the chart
examples.prompt: Halothane (\(n=9\), mean 2.08, SD 1.05) and morphine (\(n=16\), mean 1.75, SD 0.88) were compared for best cardiac index in \(\mathrm{L/min/m^2}\), and the difference was not significant. What is the power to detect a difference in cardiac index of \(2.08-1.75=0.33\) with \(\alpha=0.05\)?

steps.say: The effect to detect is the gap between the two group means.
Pool the two variances, weighting each by its degrees of freedom, and take the square root to get the SD.
The difference is only about a third of an SD, so it is a small effect.
Use n of 9 because the smaller group limits the power. At phi of 0.35 the curves sit at about 0.1, so the study had only about a 10 percent chance of finding this difference.
